title: Consistent Submodular Maximization with Full Foresight
abstract: arXiv:2611.06223v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Online algorithms with bounded recourse face three intertwined obstacles: uncertainty about the future, computational limits, and a limited budget for changes. We ask a fundamental question that separates consistency from the other two: what does solution stability cost when the entire future is known and computation is unlimited?   We answer this question for monotone submodular maximization, where an algorithm must maintain a solution of at most $k$ arrived elements, with a constant number of changes per step. We determine the optimal approximation thresholds: $3/4$ for deterministic algorithms and $\xi^\star \approx 0.7942$ for randomized algorithms. For every $\varepsilon>0$, we get within $\varepsilon$ of these thresholds with worst-case recourse polynomial in $1/\varepsilon$, independent of $k$ and the stream length. translated_title: 具有完全预见性的一致次模最大化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.06223v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：具有有界变更代价的在线算法面临三个相互交织的障碍：对未来的不确定性、计算能力的限制以及有限的变更预算。我们提出了一个能将“一致性”与其他两个因素区分开来的根本性问题：当整个未来完全已知且计算能力不受限制时，保持解的稳定性需要付出什么代价？我们针对单调次模最大化问题回答了这一问题，其中算法必须维护一个由至多 $k$ 个已到达元素组成的解，且每步只允许常数次变更。我们确定了最优近似阈值：确定性算法为 $3/4$，随机算法为 $\xi^\star \approx 0.7942$。对于任意 $\varepsilon>0$，我们都能以最坏情况下与 $1/\varepsilon$ 呈多项式关系（且与 $k$ 和流的长度无关）的变更代价达到距这些阈值 $\varepsilon$ 以内的效果。我们甚至对覆盖函数证明了匹配的不可能性结果。我们通过最优地平衡……（原文在此截断）
tldr: 该论文在“完全预知未来且计算不受限”的理想设定下，刻画了单调次模最大化中解稳定性（一致性）的代价，证明了确定性算法与随机算法的最优近似阈值分别为 3/4 和约 0.7942，并以多项于 1/ε 的变更代价逼近该阈值，同时对覆盖函数给出了匹配的不可能性证明。
en_tdlr: The paper characterizes the cost of consistency in monotone submodular maximization under full foresight and unlimited computation, establishing optimal approximation thresholds of 3/4 for deterministic and ξ*≈0.7942 for randomized algorithms, achievable with poly(1/ε) recourse and matched by impossibility results even for coverage functions.
